items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: Mr. Dean was one of the arranging teachers.

ctx.x: Who taught you, did you have a different teacher for each subject? Yeah. Did you remember who the teachers were there?

Mr. Dean was one of the arranging teachers. Ms. Moulton. Ms. Moulton was a voice teacher. What was this little lady? Or the lady that taught piano to me was Ms. Moulton. Ms. Moulton. She's from Xavier University. She taught me. I got private piano. So you know what was that? The lady that taught piano to me was from Ms. Moulton. Ms. Moulton. She's from Xavier University. She taught me. I got private piano lessons every day, one album every day. Who was our arrangement? We had a theory teacher, we had an advanced…
